# RR-50: no hand pins. The commits of opf, opf-pptx and opf-editor and the golden baseline (OPF_GOLDEN_BASELINE, exported
      # to the later steps) come from core's ecosystem.lock.json, written by the roller. A `Depends-On:` trailer in the pull
      # request body tests an unmerged pull request of another repository instead (core docs/ecosystem-development.md).
      - name: Resolve the coordinated commits from core's ecosystem.lock.json
        id: refs
        uses: OpenPresentation/opf/.github/actions/ecosystem-refs@main
        with:
          consumer: opf-render
          export-golden: 'true'
          # A renderer pull request that moves pixels selects its own baseline directory here, e.g.
          # opf-render/test/golden/<name> (regenerate-goldens writes into it; scripts/ecosystem-pins.mjs reads it).
          # Empty selects the lock's golden. The roller makes a non-empty value the lock's golden, so set it only for a
          # baseline that records core main's examples: core's registry run selects a reviewed core golden (or a retained
          # one, scripts/registry-golden.mjs) only while the lock's golden lives in core.
          golden-override: ''

- name: Resolve the coordinated commits from core's ecosystem.lock.json
        id: refs
        uses: OpenPresentation/opf/.github/actions/ecosystem-refs@main
        with:
          consumer: opf-render
          export-golden: 'true'
          # Keep equal to the package job's golden-override (scripts/ecosystem-pins.mjs reads the first one).
          golden-override: ''

- run: npm install -g npm@11.16.0
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm audit
      - name: Verify release tag
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
        run: |
          VERSION="$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")"
          case "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" in
            "opf-render-v${VERSION}"|"@openpresentation/opf-render@v${VERSION}") ;;
            *) echo "Release tag does not match package version ${VERSION}."; exit 1 ;;
          esac
      - run: npm run typecheck
      - run: npm run validate
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run test:code
      - name: Refuse a declared unreleased core (RR-55)
        run: node scripts/published-core-gate.mjs --forbid
      - run: npm run test:packed
      - name: Verify Playwright image version
        run: node -e "if (require('playwright/package.json').version !== '1.63.0') throw new Error('Update the pinned Playwright image with the test package.');"
      - run: npm run test:browser
      - run: npm run test:code-browser
      - run: npm pack --dry-run
      - run: npm publish --access public --provenance

  # RR-20: every npm publish creates its GitHub Release (from 0.18 on), notes taken from the version's CHANGELOG.md section.
